jobs.title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager – Data Product Marketplace, Defense & Systems Data Fabric
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Operationalizes the Data Product Marketplace and enterprise catalog for Defense & Systems. The role manages, facilitates, and monitors the flow of data products from intake through to being consumable in the fabric: onboarding and certification intake, the catalog and discovery experience, self-service access workflows, and the adoption metrics that show whether any of it is working.
Standards come from the Principal Data Architect in the form of data-product contracts, schemas, and SLAs; policy comes from the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager. This role executes within both and owns the day-to-day consumer experience. Success improves Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost by shortening the path from a data product request to a governed, usable data product.

Job Description
Why this role
The Data Fabric only matters if people use it, and that is what this role owns: the front door, the onboarding path, and the evidence of adoption. You will work directly with data product owners across Defense & Systems, run the intake process that moves products into the fabric, and hold the consumer experience to a standard. This is hands-on product management on a platform being built now, not caretaking of one already built.

Marketplace and catalog ownership
- Own the marketplace and catalog feature backlog: search and discovery experience, data-product previews, and self-service access workflows

- Prioritize and sequence the backlog against adoption impact and the enterprise roadmap set by the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager

- Maintain catalog completeness and data passport currency as products are published, enhanced, and deprecated

Data product onboarding and certification
- Manage data-product onboarding and certification intake, working the checklist and action plan alongside Data Product Owners

- Define product specifications with owners: SLAs, uptime targets, health scores, and critical data elements

- Partner with the Principal Data Architect to return certification and onboarding decisions within the defined SLA

- Confirm the design and integration pattern for each data product is agreed before integration work is planned and scheduled

Consumer experience and adoption
- Run user research and journey mapping with data consumers to find and remove adoption friction

- Track and report adoption and usage metrics: active users, adoption rate, time-to-access, and catalog completeness

- Report adoption results to the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager for value-realization reporting to the executive sponsor

Stakeholder engagement
- Manage data-product owners across multiple P&Ls without formal authority, using clear intake criteria and transparent prioritization

- Coordinate with federated Data Quality Analysts on specification validation and SLA fit by domain

- Brief P&L Data Stewards and Solution Architects ahead of process or standard changes

Required qualifications
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience.

- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Data Product Management & Data Marketplace Operations or IT.

- Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.

Eligibility requirement
- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. GE Aerospace will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

Desired characteristics
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Business (STEM or technical major preferred).

- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager certification.

- Experience with data quality or data-product SLA and health-score frameworks.

- Working knowledge of data cataloging and self-service access tooling.

- Working knowledge of APIs and self-service data access patterns.

- Demonstrated ability to run onboarding and intake processes across multiple stakeholder groups.

- Analytical skill to define, instrument, and track adoption and usage metrics.

- Comfort operating within standards set by the Principal Data Architect and Sr Principal Technical Product Manager rather than authoring them.

- Defense, aerospace, or other regulated-industry background.

Additional Information:
The base pay range for this position is $131,000 - $174,000 annually. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 6th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

jobs.title: SAP Inventory Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
GE Aerospace’s Edison Works business is embarking on an exciting ERP journey to implement a greenfield SAP S/4HANA instance to support expected engine growth starting in 2028 and beyond. We are hiring a Digital Technology professional to administer, configure, and manage this new SAP environment.

In this role, you will lead the blueprinting of GE’s business processes, partner with a system integrator to deploy SAP S/4HANA, and ultimately act as product owner for the Inventory to Deliver (ITD) processes for Edison Works. You will define the strategic direction for the SAP deployment and integrations, collaborating closely with business partners and DT teams to establish best practices and leverage existing standards.

Job Description
This role will be responsible for leading the technical product strategy and roadmap for SAP Inventory and QM solutions , ensuring alignment with business needs.

Roles and Responsibilities:
- Own the implementation of all Material management, inventory and warehouse management functions (ie. Inbound receiving, stock locations, picking, receiving, shipping, etc) in SAP ERP for specific deployment projects.
- Own the implementation of the SAP QM module and related business processes and integrations.
- Work closely with business and DT teams to confirm setup and reporting requirements that align to GE Aerospace standards.
- Influence business stakeholders on implementing standard processes and adopting best practice ERP solutions.
- Work with third party vendor to implement SAP solution that minimizes customization and meets the business needs, using opportunity to broaden technical expertise.
- Work with broader GE Aerospace ecosystem to ensure Edison Works business follows enterprise standards and can integrate with other enterprise systems (e.g. Oracle EBS)
- Own the requirements and testing for any inventory or QM integrations needed to external systems
- Maintain a high level of functional competency regarding the standard configuration of SAP EWM and associated integrations by staying abreast of new trends, future enhancements and leveraging best practices.
- Align with functional partner to lead the delivery of product area for initial implementation and future releases.
- Ensure all systems are aligned to IT long term strategy and standards (e.g.SOX, CMMC)
- Verify all needed documentation is completed as part of program delivery.

Qualifications/Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 5 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 10 years of professional experience
- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in ERP Product Management
- Experience with foundational ERP concepts across multiple modules
- Experience implementing or supporting complex ERP projects (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
- Minimum of 5 years professional experience in technical product management
- NOTE: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience:
- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.  We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.
- Due to the nature of the work being performed this role requires the individual to obtain and maintain US Government Security Clearance.
Experience with foundational ERP concepts across multiple modules
- Experience implementing or supporting complex ERP projects (SAP, Oracle, etc.)

Desired Characteristics:
- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience with SAP; preferred to have S4/HANA experience.
- Strong experience in delivering enterprise-wide inventory/warehouse management, and production planning IT solutions. ERP implementation experience is preferred.
- Experience integrating an ERP system to MES or non-ERP system
- Experience with GE applications such as Centerpiece, ETQ, TeamCenter
- Experience collaborating across multiple business and IT teams to align priorities and influence delivery
- Strong team player, listens, collaborates, and actively incorporates input from various sources
- Strong analytical and strong problem-solving skills; effectively evaluates information/data to make decisions.
- High level of energy and enthusiasm with the ability to thrive in a rapidly changing environment.

jobs.title: Sr Staff Technical Program Manager - Solumina
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
The Edison Works organization is a key growth area within GE Aerospace with engine output expected to grow significantly over the next few years. This cross functional organization consists of program management, operations, engineering, supply chain, digital technology, and security who are partnering to transform and deliver that growth.

Within Edison Works Digital Technology, GE is seeking an experienced Product Owner/TPM to join our Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) team. In this role you will develop new capabilities that will transform how GE Aerospace designs, manufactures, assembles, and validates our next generation aircraft engines. You will partner with product management teams to create a clear strategic direction for product needs and convey that vision to the build and/or operations team. You will direct the team with a clear and descriptive set of requirements and partner with the team to determine what can be delivered through balancing the need for new features, defects, and technical debt. Your priority is seamless integration and alignment of perspectives from a broad set of stakeholders: Product Managers, Technical Anchors, Product Owners and Developers. Key areas of focus will be standardizing digital products/integrations and processes to enable scalable growth in the use of the technologies.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Own the relationship between business process needs and Solumina MOM capabilities, serving as the DT functional expert for the platform.

- Lead requirements gathering, solution definition, and prioritization with stakeholders across manufacturing sites and headquarters.

- Drive integration strategy and execution across Solumina, SAP, PLM, MES, and ERP systems.

- Establish KPIs and success measures to improve adoption, process performance, and business value.

- Build and maintain the product roadmap, implementation plans, and cross-functional delivery alignment.

- Partner with users, leaders, and technical teams to gather feedback, resolve issues, and continuously improve the solution.

- Influence product direction through collaboration with internal GE Aerospace teams and external product/vendor discussions where applicable.

- Provide domain leadership in MOM/MES processes, manufacturing operations, and enabling technologies.

Minimum Requirement
- Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of   5   years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of   10   years of professional experience

- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Technical   Product Ownership/Product Management or Information Technology.

- Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience

Eligibility Requirement
- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.  We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

- Due to the nature of the work being performed, this role requires the individual to obtain and maintain US Government Security Clearance.

Desired Skills
- Deep domain depth in smart factory and manufacturing business processes.

- Experience implementing MES and production optimizations products preferred but not mandatory.

- Knowledge of Model Based Enterprise concepts.

- Experience with SCRUM/Agile software development methods.

- Understanding of Lean continuous improvement principles and methods.

- Basic knowledge of Computational Geometry concepts/application (e.g., NX).

- Basic understanding of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) configuration and customization (e.g., Teamcenter).

- Basic knowledge of shop floor Operational Technology concepts with a focus on CNC control systems and software implementation.

- Active US DOD Security Clearance.

- Understanding and knowledge of DT Security control frameworks (i.e. NIST, ISO, etc.) as well regulatory requirements impacting DT systems (i.e. DFARS, ITAR, DoD/MoD, etc.).

jobs.title: IT Product Owner for Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
At Avio Aero, a GE Aerospace Business unit, we’ve been reimagining the power of flight for more than 100 years. We are specialized in the design, production and maintenance of components and systems for both the civil and military aviation.

As IT Product Owner for Supply Chain, you will lead the evolution and management of digital platforms and drive projects that enable the Avio Aero Supply Chain organization to meet the specific requirements and regulations of military programs, with a particular focus on manufacturing and quality processes.
In this role you will ensure alignment with civil program platforms, leveraging shared blueprints, infrastructures, and vendors to maximize efficiency.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Own the whole Digital application lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment, adoption, and maintenance.
- Manage project schedule, risks, costs, and any non-standard events ensuring successful delivery and measurable customer impact through KPIs.
- Act as a bridge between Business functions, IT, external stakeholders maintaining clear communication with end-users and management.
- Contribute to the Digital operations to ensure business continuity, efficiency, and ongoing improvement.
- Proactively explore alternate technologies and make informed choices based on experience and impact analysis.
- Lead cross-functional teams to deliver digital solutions that meet military program requirements while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
- Ensure compliance to GE standards and practices, driving IT operational excellence.
- Partner with Business Leaders and Users to identify needs, improve business processes and deliver effective digital solutions.
- Ensure alignment with the broader GE Aerospace within DT Function.
- Strongly interact and collaborate within Digital Technology teams in all Sites.
- Develop key Business process knowledge to support Supply Chain operations.
- Serve as the site focal point for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ensuring alignment between business requirements, operational needs, and digital technology solutions.
- Own the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) product roadmap for the assigned site(s), balancing business priorities, operational needs, and technology strategy.
- Act as the primary point of contact between Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Digital Technology teams for MES-related initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
- Drive the adoption, enhancement, and operational support of MES solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise standards.
- Identify opportunities to improve shopfloor processes through MES capabilities, digital manufacturing technologies, and integration with enterprise systems.
- Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in MES and shopfloor digital processes, acting as a trusted advisor for Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality organizations.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline.
- Good knowledge of Supply Chain processes.
- Experience working with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), preferably DELMIA Apriso, or equivalent shopfloor digital solutions.
- Understanding of manufacturing processes and shopfloor operations within a complex industrial environment.
- Ability to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into digital solutions and process improvements.
- Problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset.
- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams.
- Team-oriented attitude and inclusiveness.
- Ability to work in ambiguity and deliver solutions with clear assumptions.
- Ability to exploit new technologies to improve Supply Chain processes.
- Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and drive adoption across diverse teams.
- Fluent in Czech and English (spoken and written).
- EU work permit.

Desired characteristics
- Previous experience in similar role.
- Good customer-oriented approach with a focus on quality and cost.
- Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), preferably DELMIA Apriso.
- Knowledge of manufacturing digitalization, shopfloor connectivity, Industrial IoT, or Industry 4.0 solutions.
- Experience supporting manufacturing process transformation and digital adoption initiatives.
- Familiarity with aerospace, manufacturing, or highly regulated industrial environments.
- Competencies in Agile and Scrum methodologies.
- Ability to use Lean and 6 sigma tools and drive change.
- Good analytical and problem resolution skills.
- Motivated to grow, proactive and able to set own action plans.

What we offer

Smart working and work life-balance
Avio Aero, when possible, promotes remote work and encourages a good, healthy and satisfying work-life balance. We value our employees’ wellbeing; hence we offer a variety of improvement programs aimed to preserve anyone’s psychological safety and daily needs.

At Avio Aero, we understand the importance of Total Rewards. As a new joiner to Avio Aero we are pleased to offer the following welcome benefit plan:
